description: This file defines the RouteCollector class, which is part of the Slim Framework for PHP. It manages route collection, grouping, caching, and path generation for a web application.

classes.name: RouteCollector
classes.description: A class responsible for collecting route definitions, managing route groups, caches, and generating URLs compatible with the Slim Framework.

methods.name: getRouteParser
methods.description: Returns the route parser instance used for parsing route patterns.

methods.name: getDefaultInvocationStrategy
methods.description: Retrieves the default invocation strategy for route handling.

methods.name: setDefaultInvocationStrategy
methods.description: Sets the invocation strategy that will be used by default for route execution.

methods.name: getCacheFile
methods.description: Returns the path to the cache file used for route caching, or null if caching is disabled.

methods.name: setCacheFile
methods.description: Sets the cache file for route caching, validating permissions.

methods.name: getBasePath
methods.description: Retrieves the base URL path used in URL generation.

methods.name: setBasePath
methods.description: Sets the base URL path used for URL generation.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Returns all the routes currently collected.

methods.name: removeNamedRoute
methods.description: Removes a route by its name from the collection.

methods.name: getNamedRoute
methods.description: Retrieves a route by its name, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: lookupRoute
methods.description: Finds a route by its identifier, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Creates a route group with shared pattern and behavior.

methods.name: createGroup
methods.description: Protected method that initializes a route group.

methods.name: createProxy
methods.description: Creates proxy object for route grouping.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Adds a new route with specified methods, pattern, and handler.

methods.name: createRoute
methods.description: Constructs a new Route object with specified parameters.
